# HyperUI source reference

Pinned revision: `b3941ba0e361bd827c27f462eaecbb04879bd20e`.

`banner-split.html` is a layout excerpt of `public/examples/marketing/banners/3.html` (unused SVG illustration omitted); `banner-center.html` is `public/examples/marketing/banners/1.html`. Their responsive split/center hero layout and dual CTA structure are adapted into `patterns/agency-home.php` and `assets/styles/agency.css`. Tailwind utilities are translated into scoped native CSS; the upstream SVG illustration is replaced by a Codela interface concept. The user-supplied agency draft supplies the three service categories and service copy direction. No React, Tailwind CDN or third-party JavaScript runtime is shipped.

License is included in the production theme as `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES-agency.txt`.
